baseline_models.focus_anchor: The question ءَأَمِنتُم is overturned by يَخْسِفَ and the sudden فَإِذَا هِىَ تَمُورُ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Felt security borrows the stillness of the supporting ground and treats it as guaranteed. Sinking removes that support, while oscillation removes every stable reference point, so bodily motion exposes the false premise inside the heart's repose.

activation_trace.role: Heart-settling security supplies the presumed stillness that the question overturns.
Engulfment into the earth removes the support on which that repose rested.
The lower counterpart to the sky supplies the apparently fixed supporting plane.
Back-and-forth undulation converts presumed repose into disorientation.

changed_reading.before: The ayah warns that the ground may move.
changed_reading.after: The ayah exposes felt safety as a psychological stillness borrowed from a ground that can itself be made to lose stillness.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction مَّن فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ أَن يَخْسِفَ بِكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ links an above-domain agent to a below-domain collapse.
baseline_models.mechanism: The addressees occupy the interval between an overshadowing above and a supporting below. Agency from the upper domain makes the lower domain swallow them, so the very vertical arrangement that seems to enclose them safely becomes the channel of exposure.

activation_trace.role: What is high enough to overshadow supplies the upper boundary of the vertical mechanism.
Downward engulfment carries the effect from the upper agent into the lower boundary.
The lower counterpart to the sky becomes an active swallowing surface rather than a passive floor.

changed_reading.before: The threat comes from a remote power above.
changed_reading.after: The threat is a vertical reversal in which control from above turns the addressees' own lower support against them.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence ٱلْأَرْضَ فَإِذَا هِىَ تَمُورُ attributes wave-like motion to the ground.
baseline_models.mechanism: A load-bearing solid loses its material category: engulfment opens depth, then oscillation and flow make the ground behave like a transporting medium. The addressees are not merely struck on the earth; they are carried by its phase-like change.

activation_trace.role: The ground's inward opening removes the integrity of the solid surface.
The ordinary lower support is the material whose behavior is transformed.
Undulation gives the former floor the repeated motion of a wave.
Recurrent flow and pouring sharpen the ground's conversion into a carrying medium.

changed_reading.before: The ayah depicts a local subsidence followed by shaking.
changed_reading.after: The ayah depicts the trusted solid changing into an engulfing, wave-like medium that transports those standing on it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The inward assurance activated by ءَأَمِنتُم is answered by the bodily lowering of يَخْسِفَ بِكُمُ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The security-question can probe an inwardly accepted guarantee, not only an absence of fear. The humiliation branch of sinking turns that inward assent into enforced lowliness, and the earth's clinging weight plus its motion deprive the addressees of mastery over posture.

activation_trace.role: Heart-settled assent supplies an exploratory cognitive layer to the addressees' security.
A degrading burden turns presumed mastery into compelled lowliness.
Clinging and heaviness toward the ground give the abasement a bodily posture.
Oscillation removes the bodily control that the assured posture presupposed.

changed_reading.after: Their security may also be an inwardly ratified guarantee whose answer is forced bodily abasement and loss of control.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding ayah presents earth's traversability as a conferred state: it is made tractable, walked upon, and approached by its sides. The focus threat is therefore a reversal of maintained usability; the same earth ceases to cooperate and changes from road-like support into an engulfing, moving body.

activation_trace.role: Making something assume a state marks terrestrial usability as conferred rather than inherent.
The same lower support is named immediately before its threatened reversal.
Facilitation after difficulty supplies the earth's revocable cooperative state.
Ordinary walking is the bodily operation that stable terrain presently enables.
The earth's sides or shoulders make it a traversable body whose posture can change.
Engulfment is the first reversal of the conferred traversability.
Undulation completes the reversal by making ordinary walking impossible.

structural_cues: 67:15 and 67:16 are adjacent and repeat the same earth while reversing its behavior from tractable to engulfing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a made, facilitated earth, walking, and its sides; I infer that usability is a maintained state whose withdrawal appears as sinking and swaying, while a live alternative treats the pair as a simpler favor-then-threat contrast.

changed_reading.before: A normally stable earth is interrupted by an exceptional disaster.
changed_reading.after: Normal stability is itself a conferred mode of the earth, and the disaster is the withdrawal and reversal of that tractability.

context_deltas.mechanism: The paired question in 67:17 repeats security and the sky-domain but switches the pathway from earth swallowing below to a stone-bearing wind sent from above. Together they close off the imagined safe direction: the addressees are exposed through both boundaries of their vertical habitat.

activation_trace.role: Downward engulfment supplies the lower route of exposure.
The lower boundary becomes the first active hazard.
Repeated heart-settling security binds the two hazard routes into one challenge.
The same overshadowing upper domain supplies the second boundary of exposure.
Dispatch and release provide the downward vector from the upper domain.
A stone-bearing wind turns the upper boundary into a material hazard.

structural_cues: 67:16-17 form an adjacent أَمْ alternative pair with repeated security and sky language but opposed downward routes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two parallel questions, engulfment below, and a dispatched storm above; I infer a deliberately closed vertical enclosure, while a live alternative reads the pair only as two independent examples of power.

changed_reading.before: The addressees face one particular geological danger.
changed_reading.after: Their security assumes a safe direction, but the paired questions expose them through both the ground below and the canopy above.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier repeated inspection finds no visible breach in the upper order and sends sight back exhausted. The focus question can therefore target an epistemic overreach: observed regularity has been converted into a warranty of personal safety, even though the inspection never established immunity from the agency associated with that ordered height.

activation_trace.role: Repeated ocular inspection supplies the finite evidence from which immunity might be over-inferred.
The searched-for opening or fissure defines the visible defect that cannot be found.
Returning the gaze makes inspection iterative rather than casual.
Exhausted power marks the limit of what repeated inspection can establish.
Felt security is recast as a conclusion that outruns the inspected evidence.
The visually ordered upper canopy is also the domain from which the threat is framed.

structural_cues: The earlier double visual challenge and the later security question both interrogate what the addressees think the ordered sky permits them to conclude.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated sight, absence of a visible fissure, exhausted inspection, and later security; I infer an illicit step from regularity to immunity, while a live alternative keeps the cosmological inspection and personal warning separate.

changed_reading.before: Security is simple fearlessness despite a threat.
changed_reading.after: Security may be an epistemic mistake: treating successfully observed order as proof that the observer cannot be exposed within that order.

context_deltas.mechanism: The nearby positive posture is fear maintained in hiddenness. That contrast changes أَمِنتُم from generic calm into the inverse response to unseen agency: the addressees turn lack of sensory access into safety, whereas the contrasted group remains affectively responsive without visibility.

activation_trace.role: Fear joined with awe supplies the affective counter-posture to complacent security.
Concealment from the eyes shows that responsive fear need not wait for visible danger.
Heart-settling security becomes the affective misuse of non-visibility.
The remote upper domain makes the challenged agency unavailable to ordinary sight.

structural_cues: 67:12 places responsive fear in hiddenness, while 67:13-14 continue the contrast between concealed and manifest access before 67:16 asks about security.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies awe despite hiddenness and later challenges security; I infer that non-visibility has been converted into presumed absence, while a live alternative treats 67:12 only as a description of another group's virtue.

changed_reading.before: The addressees feel safe because no danger is presently seen.
changed_reading.after: The question exposes their conversion of hiddenness into safety, in direct contrast to a fear that remains responsive without sight.

context_deltas.mechanism: Birds above alternate extension and contraction yet remain held. This makes stable support an ongoing act rather than an inert property: the earth can bear the addressees only while its supporting behavior is maintained, and تَمُورُ becomes legible as release or alteration of that holding relation.

activation_trace.role: The lower support is reclassified from an autonomous floor to a maintained relation.
Undulation marks a change in the relation that had kept terrain behavior stable.
Spatial height places another vulnerable body in the same upper-lower field as the focus.
Level extension supplies one visible phase of sustained flight.
Contraction after extension supplies the alternating phase without loss of support.
Active restraint is the explicit relation that prevents the suspended bodies from falling.

structural_cues: 67:19 returns to bodies above immediately after the paired threats and explains their stable position through active holding.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies alternating wings and explicit holding; I transfer that maintained-support logic to the focus earth, while a live alternative limits the holding image to flight and leaves terrestrial stability implicit.

changed_reading.before: Earth supports by its own fixed nature until it is attacked.
changed_reading.after: Support is continuously maintained, and the earth's churning is a change in an active holding relation rather than a violation of autonomy.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later questions strip away social defense and material supply: a mutually supporting force cannot aid, and provision can be withheld. The branch image of deceptive glitter that does not endure sharpens the focus security as confidence assembled from contingent supports, including the apparently dependable earth underfoot.

activation_trace.role: Felt safety is the state produced by treating borrowed supports as durable guarantees.
The floor underfoot is one such apparently self-sufficient support.
A mutually supporting force supplies the imagined social structure of safety.
Aid and making-prevail define the protective outcome expected from that force.
A glittering appearance that does not endure names the mechanism by which contingent support feels secure.
Allocated provision supplies the material system on which ordinary confidence depends.
Withholding reveals that the material support remains controlled and revocable.

structural_cues: 67:20-21 repeat rhetorical questions about who can sustain protection and provision after 67:16-17 challenge physical safety.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed military aid, deceptive appearance, allocated provision, and possible withholding; I infer a common dependency structure extending to ground-security, while a live alternative keeps social, economic, and geological supports as separate examples.

changed_reading.before: The ayah denies immunity from a physical event.
changed_reading.after: It also probes a security assembled from borrowed social, material, and terrestrial supports whose apparent durability can deceive.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later walking contrast turns terrain into a moral-spatial interface: one body is inverted onto its face, while another is whole and upright on a directed path. The focus earth's engulfment and sway remove the conditions for upright navigation, externalizing in the environment the disorientation figured in face-down walking.

activation_trace.role: The lower plane is the interface on which bodily orientation depends.
Oscillation destroys a stable directional frame for walking.
The repeated act of walking makes orientation a contrastive operation rather than scenery.
Being overturned onto the face supplies the failed posture that engulfment can impose.
Bodily wholeness and straightness supply the opposed stable posture.
Straightness and balance define the directional condition that a swaying ground removes.

structural_cues: Walking on the tractable earth in 67:15, losing stable earth in 67:16, and contrasted walking in 67:22 form a repeated navigation sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two bodily orientations on a path and the focus supplies unstable terrain; I infer that environmental instability externalizes failed orientation, while a live alternative reads 67:22 solely as an independent moral simile.

changed_reading.before: Sinking and swaying threaten bodily survival.
changed_reading.after: They also abolish upright navigability, making the loss of physical orientation enact the later contrast between inverted and straight walking.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later demand for the promised event treats threat as safely postponable, but its realization is pictured as rushing into nearness. This activates the focus فَإِذَا as a temporal trapdoor: security may rest less on denying the event than on keeping it indefinitely remote, and the sudden sway collapses that distance.

activation_trace.role: Felt security is recast as repose produced by temporal distance.
The suddenly present oscillation supplies the event that terminates postponement.
A promise bounded by time or place supplies the event the speakers try to locate at a distance.
Fulfillment in deed makes the challenged promise a realizable event rather than mere speech.
A rush into proximity supplies the collapse of the temporal buffer.

structural_cues: The focus uses the abrupt فَإِذَا transition, while 67:25-27 move from demanding the event's time to seeing it close.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a time-bounded threat, a demand for verification, abrupt focus grammar, and later nearness; I infer that postponement itself generates security, while a live alternative reads the later sequence as unrelated eschatological timing.

changed_reading.before: The addressees deny or ignore a possible danger.
changed_reading.after: They may feel safe by assigning danger to an indefinite later, and the ayah's sudden transition destroys that temporal shelter.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing sequence asks who can place people under protection, then pairs belief with explicit reliance upon the Merciful. This prevents the focus from condemning all security alike: it contrasts self-enclosed immunity with an entrusted posture that acknowledges a protector and transfers the affair rather than presuming control.

activation_trace.role: Unqualified felt security supplies the challenged self-contained posture.
Protective neighborhood or guarantee makes safety explicitly relational.
Merciful tenderness names the relation in which the later trust is placed.
Heart-settled belief supplies a constructive counterpart to the challenged self-security.
Reliance transfers the affair and defines security as acknowledged dependence.

structural_cues: The same security-belief root recurs in 67:29 with an explicit object and is immediately paired with reliance, unlike the interrogated security of 67:16.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies challenged security, a question about protection, belief in mercy, and reliance; I infer a contrast between autonomous immunity and entrusted dependence, while a live alternative distinguishes the two occurrences grammatically without making them opposing postures.

changed_reading.before: The ayah rejects feeling secure before divine power.
changed_reading.after: It rejects self-securing immunity while the surah later preserves a different repose: belief joined to explicit, relational reliance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing water question supplies a precise material analogue for the focus sinking branch: a sustaining substance descends beyond access, and the desired counter-state is a flowing spring brought back to the surface. The focus then reads not only as terrain collapse but as withdrawal of surface accessibility, with bodies following the same downward vector as vanished water.

activation_trace.role: A well or its water going deep supplies the focus root's latent accessibility-loss mechanism.
The surface-lower boundary is where access is first presumed and then removed.
Recurrent flow lets the transformed ground participate in the water-like material analogy.
Water supplies the sustaining material whose accessibility can be withdrawn or restored.
Descent into depth supplies the terminal surah analogue to focus engulfment.
A flowing spring supplies the accessible surface state whose loss the question dramatizes.

structural_cues: The surah closes with downward disappearance into depth and a question about restored access, echoing the focus's downward engulfment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a focus branch for deep or vanished well-water and a closing contrast between deep water and a flowing spring; I extend that access-reversal to the people engulfed with the earth, while a live alternative keeps water loss and land collapse as separate power examples.

changed_reading.before: The earth opens and shakes around the addressees.
changed_reading.after: The surface itself withdraws accessibility: people descend like water gone beyond reach, while the ground acquires a recurrent, fluid behavior.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads the earlier fire's boiling and near-tearing as a material analogue for the focus earth rather than as a separate scene. It remains valid through the focus roots for engulfment, earth, and oscillation plus branch-backed boiling and severing cues; downstream prose should present it as a cross-scene pressure image, not assert that the ayah lexically identifies earth with fire.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The outlier remains anchored in يَخْسِفَ بِكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ and especially the agitated تَمُورُ.

activation_trace.role: Boiling and surging supply a pressurized material analogue to the focus oscillation.
Near-severing supplies the image of a boundary strained toward rupture.
Heat's flare supplies the pressure driving the earlier churning scene.
Engulfment opens the focus surface toward what lies beneath.
The lower surface becomes the boundary that can transmit the churning.
Wave-like agitation is the focus behavior sharpened by the earlier boiling scene.

changed_reading.before: The earth shakes as an isolated geological surface.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the earth behaves like a strained boundary transmitting the surah's earlier boiling, near-rending pressure from below.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the packet's form-distant س م م target under the focus root س م و and imagines the sky as an apertured overhead enclosure. It remains anchored because that split target is explicitly supplied for the focus word and context supplies a searched-for fissure plus a dispatched stone-bearing wind; downstream prose must label it as branch resonance, not claim that سَمَاء lexically means a narrow hole.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The activation attaches to ٱلسَّمَآءِ as the overhead domain through which the paired threats are spatially organized.

activation_trace.role: A searched-for fissure supplies the possibility of an opening in the inspected canopy.
The supplied split branch of a narrow ingress recasts the upper domain as potentially penetrable.
Dispatch supplies movement through or from the upper domain.
The stone-bearing wind supplies the material that arrives through the imagined upper conduit.

changed_reading.before: The sky is only a remote location named in the threat.
changed_reading.after: As an explicitly exploratory branch resonance, the upper canopy becomes a conduit whose apparent closure does not prevent force from arriving.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it treats human dispersal on earth through the supplied sowing image and then reads engulfment as a dark reverse sowing before gathering. It remains anchored in the focus earth and sinking construction and in 67:24's branch-backed distribution and collection; downstream prose should retain it only as an ecological-spatial analogy, not as an asserted ritual or doctrinal sequence.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The reading attaches to ٱلْأَرْضَ as fertile receiving medium and to يَخْسِفَ بِكُمُ as movement of people into it.

activation_trace.role: Engulfment supplies the downward placement of bodies into the receiving earth.
Soft fertile earth supplies the receiving medium for the sowing analogy.
Sowing the earth gives human dispersal an ecological placement image.
Driving a dispersed group toward one destination supplies the reversal from scattering to collection.

changed_reading.before: The earth merely swallows a settled population.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, engulfment becomes a reverse sowing of those dispersed across the earth, anticipating their movement from distribution toward collection.

strongest_changes: The tractable earth of 67:15 makes stability a conferred and revocable behavior, not an autonomous terrestrial property.
The paired threat in 67:17 closes the vertical habitat from below and above, while 67:19 reframes all stable support as active holding.
The reuse of ء م ن with reliance in 67:29 distinguishes challenged self-security from entrusted dependence.
The deep-water ending in 67:30 activates the focus root's hidden well-water branch and recasts sinking as loss of surface accessibility.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah sits at a hinge where a made-walkable earth becomes an engulfing moving medium, then is immediately paired with an upper-air hazard. Later flight, walking, reliance, and disappearing water repeatedly reactivate support, orientation, and access without forcing those mechanisms into one final interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: The packet does not settle how literally or relationally the construction مَن فِي السَّمَاءِ should be rendered, so the trace preserves its vertical function without identifying or localizing the agent.
The cognitive-assent layer of ءَأَمِنتُم is branch-supported but remains weaker than the direct felt-safety reading.
The boiling-boundary, apertured-canopy, and reverse-sowing readings are live cross-domain activations but should remain explicitly exploratory in downstream prose.
